name: Fedders Holding Ltd
summary: Fedders Holding Ltd. engages in the business of investment, finance, and consultancy. It focuses on distress debt resolution advisory services such as fund-raising consultancy, asset management service, transaction advisory, sales, and marketing advisory. The company was founded by Nirmal Kumar Deepchand Gangwal on October 22, 1991 and is headquartered in Ghaziabad, India.
